fields.summary_ko.0: Lakewood Capital Management ($3.4B AUM) entered SK hynix (SKHY:NASDAQ) in Q3; down 44% since September 30 but undervalued ~3x on net income basis.
fields.summary_ko.1: Brink's (BCO:NYSE) and S&P Global (SPGI:NYSE) also added positions, up 12% and 11% respectively since September 30, with Brink's strongest supported by analyst upgrade and 18% EPS growth.
